_comment: Pax weight configuration. Updated by reviewing pax_replay output and manually editing this file. Restart dashboard to pick up changes.

conviction_source_weights._comment: Base weights for the anchored multi-source conviction engine. Sums to ~1.18; effective weights are normalized at runtime by sum(|effective|) after reliability gating and cluster caps.

conviction_clusters._comment: Correlation clusters. Sources not listed here are unclustered (no cap). Effective weights inside a cluster are scaled down proportionally if their absolute sum exceeds the cluster cap.

conviction_windows_sec._comment: Anchored rolling windows for per-source SMA. 'short' = fast-reaction window. 'medium' = primary stability window. 'session' is anchored at 08:30 CT.

conviction_aggregation_weights._comment: Per-source aggregation across the three time horizons. Must sum to 1.0.

conviction_thresholds._comment: Composite score thresholds for trend label, plus SMA-slope thresholds for trajectory.

_legacy_comment: The fields below are the pre-v2 EMA model. Kept for backward compatibility — read by no live code path but referenced by legacy helper tests that pin _regime_to_signal / _slope_to_signal / _level_to_signal sign conventions.

subgroup_overrides._comment: Per-subgroup multipliers applied AFTER regime boost. Populated by pax_replay --recommend after enough sessions of data.
